note: Which narrated sentence opens each reveal, as a 0-based sentence index into
that segment's recorded paragraph. One entry per `await ctx.waitForNext()`,
in order. scripts/derive-advances.mjs turns these into the advance times in
audio/tracks/v1/track.ts, so the picture changes on the sentence that
explains it and a re-record re-times the whole film in one command. When two
reveals cite one sentence, that sentence's speaking time is divided evenly
